fusions.name: Run to Exhaustion
fusions.desc: A spear thrust that deals 26 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. The target is left [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds and [Enervated] for 8 seconds, so its health, mana and stamina crawl back.

fusions.name: Heavy Tread
fusions.desc: Stamps the ground, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 25% chance per hit to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Marching Breath
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 10 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Ground Eaten Up
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%.
